note: Insert View is a single @Filter plugin (id insert_view, TYPE_TRANSFORM_IRREVERSIBLE) plus a hook_help(). No configure route, no permissions, no services, no config schema, no Drush. Its only persistent state is per-text-format: filter.format.<id> -> filters.insert_view.status/weight. The tag grammar is the real regex in InsertView::process(): [view:name=display=args=limit:number], display defaults to 'default', args are slash-separated and support %N path substitution, limit maps to setItemsPerPage(). Medium cases install real filter_format config and a real node body so the answer must be read off the live site. Hard cases require enabling the filter on a format and authoring a node that really embeds a view; both verifies render the text through check_markup/processed_text and assert the view actually expanded (view-id-frontpage in the output), not just that config was written.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal contrib module insert_view, what is the exact tag syntax for embedding a view in a formatted text field? Show the tag that embeds the view `my_view`, display `block_1`, with the contextual filter arguments 12 and 2024, limited to 5 rows.
evals.expected_output: The syntax is [view:name=display=args=limit:number], so: [view:my_view=block_1=12/2024=limit:5]. Multiple arguments are slash separated; if the display id is omitted the view's `default` display is used; limit:0 shows all results.

evals.prompt: I installed insert_view on Drupal 11 but [view:...] tags in my node bodies are printed literally. There is no settings page for the module - what do I have to do, and what config does that change?
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'Insert View' filter on the text format the field uses: /admin/config/content/formats -> Configure -> tick Insert View -> Save. That writes filters.insert_view.status: true (with a weight) into the filter.format.<id> config entity. The module itself has configure: null and no settings.

evals.prompt: Why does the insert_view module's documentation say the filter should only be granted to trusted users, and what access check does it actually perform when rendering an embedded view?
evals.expected_output: InsertView::build() only calls $view->access($display_id) and silently renders nothing when it fails - so anyone who can write text in a format with this filter enabled can render ANY view display named in the tag, including the often-unrestricted `default` display. Grant the filter only on formats restricted to trusted roles and audit access settings on every display.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has several text formats. Inspect the running site and tell me which text format currently has the Insert View filter enabled (so that [view:...] tags expand in it), and what weight the filter is given in that format.
evals.expected_output: iv_probe, with the insert_view filter at weight 7 (filter.format.iv_probe -> filters.insert_view.status: true, weight: 7). The similarly named iv_plain format has the filter present but status: false.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a node titled 'IV Probe Landing' whose body embeds a view with an insert_view tag. Inspect the live content and tell me which view machine name and which display id it embeds, plus the arguments and row limit the tag passes.
evals.expected_output: The body contains [view:archive=block_1=2019/06=limit:4] in the iv_tag text format: view `archive`, display `block_1`, contextual filter arguments 2019 and 06, limited to 4 rows.

evals.prompt: My Drupal site has a text format called 'IV Task format' (machine name iv_task). Right now if someone types a [view:...] tag in text using that format, the tag just shows up as literal text instead of showing the listing. Please make that format actually turn those tags into the real listing, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the insert_view filter on filter.format.iv_task (status: true) - via /admin/config/content/formats or $format->setFilterConfig('insert_view', ['status' => TRUE, ...])->save(). Verified by rendering '[view:frontpage=page_1]' through the iv_task format and finding the frontpage view's markup in the output.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the text format iv_embed already has the Insert View filter enabled. Create a published Article node titled exactly 'IV Embed Task' whose body uses the iv_embed format and, using insert_view's tag syntax, embeds the `frontpage` view's `page_1` display limited to 3 rows. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An Article node 'IV Embed Task' with body.format = iv_embed and a body value containing [view:frontpage=page_1==limit:3] (the empty third segment is the omitted arguments; [view:frontpage=page_1==3] is equivalent). Verified by rendering the body as processed_text and finding the frontpage view's markup.
